How did we define your grade? Grading Report

We have developed Grading Reports to give our collectors an insight into the grading process and the reasons that any specific card achieved the grade stated by Ace Grading.

Our Grading Reports include what other companies call 'subgrades', however ours do not work in exactly the same way.

Our system takes into account the key Points of Interest of a card, as well as our subgrades, which gives the overall grade.

Not all Points of Interest affect our subgrade scores, and may represent areas of Additional Observations, or things to take note of on your card.

Find further information along with our Grading Reports FAQ here.

What's included

  • An image with points of interest for the front and rear of your card.

  • A description of your centering score.

  • Your scores for Surfaces, Edges and Corners.

  • Brief descriptions of points of interest that have affected the overall grade of your card.
